stem: Child weighing 10kg suffered burns covering 25% of her body 6 hours ago. You need to give fluids in ED. Which of the following are correct?

options.text: 0.9% NS resus followed by 0.18% NS + 4% dextrose for maintenance with half over the first 8 hours, the rest over the remaining 16h
0.9% NS with 0.45% NS + 5% dextrose for maintenance with half over the first 2 hours, the rest over the remaining 16h
0.9% NS bolus and 0.45% + 5% dex over the next 16 hours
